meta.source: nflverse pbp for targets, air yards and team denominators; nflverse snap_counts for offensive snaps, joined on PFR id. REG season only.
meta.wopr: WOPR = 1.5 x target share + 0.7 x air-yards share, both as decimals. The standard weighting of the two halves of a receiving role, volume and depth.

qualifiers.denominators: Shares are of the TEAM total from play-by-play, not of the 350-player pool. Pool denominators would omit unrostered players and inflate every share.

caveats: ROUTES RUN IS NOT HERE. Yards per route run is the other metric this layer would want, and route participation is charted by PFF and FTN rather than recorded in play-by-play. Snap share is the closest free substitute and it is a different thing — a receiver on the field for a run play ran no route.
A week a player missed is absent rather than zero. A zero would read as "played and got nothing", which is a different fact from "did not play".
Air-yards share is undefined for a team-week with no positive air yards, and is omitted rather than sent as zero.
